purpose: across-seed order stability of ability at the locked operating point

operating_point.start: production max-info top5 seeded pick (not uniform-random)

deployment_policy: FIXED production seed (consistent with Bridge & BiGGen): single-run CAT scoring pins the RNG so first-item/tie-break choices are reproducible; the ~SE measurement uncertainty is still reported. Affects only single-run CAT, not the full-bank leaderboard.
interpretation: mean across-seed theta SD as a fraction of the SE target; <<1 means the adaptive order/seed contributes negligible variance vs measurement error.
